decision: Keep the existing cache_fresh forge-error fail-open on evaluate; do not convert a thrown drift probe into a deny

governingRule.description: Forge-outage drop-back: local work MAY continue when it does not need the forge (#3422)

alternativesConsidered.whyNot: Would deny session:start / work-selection on 429, 502/503, or DNS failure, colliding with #3422 and converting an outage into a local-write block even after cache_fresh left the write path

alternativesConsidered.option: Return a visible probe-errored verdict that still passes
alternativesConsidered.whyNot: Needs a new evaluate contract and ritual-state field; not required to land #3738, and would still be a silent pass at the gate

whyWinner: The write path no longer executes cache_fresh, so the fail-open is no longer a write-authorization bypass. Changing the evaluate outcome here would retarget session and work-selection callers without a #3422 design. Record the existing pass-on-throw as deliberate rather than leaving it silent.
revisitTrigger: If session:start or verify:cache-fresh should surface forge errors without denying local writes, add a visible probe-errored field without changing the pass/fail outcome
